audience: Curious TikTok/Reels viewers 18–40 who watch rabbit-hole content, conspiracy-adjacent videos, and 'things you didn't know' content
job: 45–60s short-form video — creator presents a layered 'iceberg' theory using AI-generated visuals or narration. Format: surface-level fact → gets weirder/deeper as it goes. Talking head or voiceover over visuals.
voiceRef: Calm but unsettling, like you're letting someone in on something most people don't know. Think late-night documentary narrator meets curious friend.
constraints: No price mentions. Hook must establish a mystery or surprising premise in the first sentence. Must have a clear 3-layer iceberg structure (obvious → strange → wild). Under 150 words. End on the deepest/wildest layer to drive saves and replays.
successCriteria: First sentence makes the viewer stop scrolling with curiosity not shock. Each layer is more surprising than the last. Final reveal is genuinely unexpected.
